validation_notes: The right side of the chart (late June through August) shows price trading in a tight, flat horizontal range around 0.0045-0.0050 with no clear convergence - both highs and lows are roughly flat, forming more of a sideways consolidation/rectangle than a descending triangle. A descending triangle requires a clearly falling upper resistance line with a flat support; here the upper boundary is not making consistently lower highs, it's mostly flat with minor noise. This looks like a basing/consolidation pattern after a strong downtrend rather than a converging triangle. Not enough distinct lower-high touch points to confirm a descending diagonal resistance line.
